newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shrs seen mixed on worries over CVRD sale.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shrs seen mixed on worries over CVRD sale.

text.p: Brazil shares are seen mixed Wednesday amid continuing fears that the April 29 privatization auction of state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) will be delayed, brokers said.

Although state officials late Tuesday said they would push ahead the auction despite a high court injunction against the government, traders are concerned that interested bidders will not take the risk of participating in the auction amid a legal dispute.
Late Tuesday, a Supreme Court judge granted an injunction suspending the transfer of 411,000 hectares in the Carajas mining area to CVRD.

They also said they would await a possible high court ruling today on two actions brought by the Order of Brazilian Lawyers (OAB), a private lawyers group, which has questioned aspects of CVRD's sell-off.
"If the Supreme Court grants this injunction, the chances for a delay would increase," one trader said.
Vale do Rio Doce off 1.34 pct at 25.75 reais
